english.note: Use this as the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the storyline of a film, book, or play.

examples.english: The plot of this film is full of twists and turns; I don't want to stop watching.
examples.traditional: 呢套戲嘅劇情峰迴路轉，睇到我唔捨得瞓。
